questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that the right lane is ending soon. You need to merge left into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction of the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is usually yellow with black markings. It tells you that an intersection is coming up so you can prepare to stop or turn if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you to drive only in the direction shown by the arrow. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows in both directions on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to drive to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided into separate directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It tells you to slow down because the road is about to make a sharp turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Triangular signs with the point facing down mean you must yield. Slow down and let other traffic pass. Stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at the marked stop line if one is present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your lane splits into two directions. You can either turn left or go straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. The speed number below tells you how fast you should go through the upcoming curve. Slow down to 35 mph or less.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It tells you the road ahead has many turns and curves. Slow down and be prepared to steer carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill or downgrade ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves. Be ready to brake.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve where the road curves right, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to prevent collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs indicate rules you must obey. This sign means slower drivers should stay in the right lane to keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then left. Slow down for these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean work zone activity ahead. Stay alert for changing conditions. This sign warns of a flagger whose directions you must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a stop sign is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means an intersection with a side road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools to tell drivers to slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn wagons, or farm vehicles may display this emblem. It warns other drivers that these vehicles travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and check all directions for traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a divided highway is starting and you should stay in the right lane.
